scripts.build: find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | grep -v scripts | xargs -I{} bash -c 'cd {} && bash ../scripts/build.sh build'
scripts.release: find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | grep -v scripts | xargs -I{} bash -c 'cd {} && bash ../scripts/build.sh release'
